title: Boat Rentals of Lake Wylie

includes: Life jackets including child sizes (under 30 lbs, 30-50 lbs, 50-90 lbs)
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats on Lake Wylie for a day on the water. Prior boating experience is required to rent. The business operates by reservation only within a gated residential community.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking, remainder due at rental · Cancellation: no charge if 7+ days before, 50% charge if within 48 hours, full charge if within 24 hours or no-show · Severe weather (strong wind, heavy rain, thunderstorms, lightning) cancels rental with reschedule or refund · 11 Blackberry Lane, Lake Wylie, SC 29710
